title: React Native Quickstart
tagline: Build a cross-platform voice AI client with React Native.
description: A bare React Native (TypeScript) voice-agent client for Agora Conversational AI. It reuses the engine-agnostic web toolkit over thin RTC/RTM engine adapters and renders live transcript, talking to a bundled keyless Python backend.
author: Agora
